name: Stochastic Opacity Masking
aliases: Stochastic Surface Interpretation via Depth Testing
definition: A mechanism to realize the stochastic surface process within a conventional depth-tested rasterization pipeline by simulating a discrete stochastic process during fragment generation, selecting a single visible surface point per pixel.
summary: Stochastic Opacity Masking is a differentiable rasterization technique that selects a single visible fragment per pixel via probabilistic thresholding, enabling gradient computation without depth sorting.
